description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy performance of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, with accuracy measured in percentage points (Pass%). The x-axis represents temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1, and is labeled “Temperature”. The y-axis represents accuracy, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2.5, and is labeled “Accuracy (Pass%)”. The plot contains three distinct lines: the On-policy RL method is represented by a yellow line with star markers; the LUFFY method is represented by a red line with star markers; and the SFT method is represented by a teal line with triangle markers. The On-policy RL line starts at approximately 65.0 at temperature 0.1, rises to a peak near 78.0 at temperature 0.4, then declines to around 70.0 at temperature 0.6 before rising again to about 77.5 at temperature 1.0. The LUFFY line begins near 77.5 at temperature 0.1, fluctuates slightly upward and downward, reaching a peak near 80.0 at temperature 0.5, then dips slightly before rising again to approximately 80.0 at temperature 1.0. The SFT line starts at approximately 77.5 at temperature 0.1, dips to about 73.0 at temperature 0.3, rises to a peak near 79.0 at temperature 0.4, then declines to about 75.0 at temperature 0.6 before rising again to approximately 79.0 at temperature 1.0.
